Lemma
[nonsingular exponential maps are covering maps]

Source: petersen:page-0257 1. ch6:6.2.1If $\exp _p:T_pM\to M$ is nonsingular everywhere (no critical points), then it is a covering map.
Proof

\sketch Nonsingular $D\exp _p$ makes the pullback metric a local isometry on $T_pM$. Radial lines are complete for this metric, so completeness of the domain gives the covering-map conclusion.

□
